name: StreamWeaver Doc Viewer
description: Renders StreamWeaver docs on GitHub the way they look when run, instead of as Ruby source.

content_security_policy.sandbox: sandbox allow-scripts allow-popups; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; child-src 'self';
